nodes.label: Hopwood: The Pasta Curves for Halo 2 and Beyond (Zcash/ECC, 2020)
nodes.author: Daira Hopwood
nodes.rationale: Pallas and Vesta form a cycle (order of each = base field of the other), critical for recursive proof efficiency. Design choices: 2-adicity 32 for FFT-friendly PLONK-style arithmetic, degree-3 isogenies for simplified-SWU hashing, 255-bit fields (126-bit rho security, 32-byte points), sparse moduli for Montgomery reduction, endomorphisms for scalar multiplication, and no small-prime multiplicative subgroups so Poseidon/Rescue exponentiation is a permutation; twist security was dropped as over-strict defence-in-depth.
